cases.detail: OBSERVED_PRODUCT_GAP: the first prompt selected registered model registered-inaccessible before its held probe resolved and surfaced provider 403 (error); another registered model had already passed its probe. The original prompt was not replayed. A distinct prompt worked only after explicit physical model selection. Decide whether first-use should visibly warn or require user selection when the active physical model is unverified; the required no-wait healthy held-probe case remains passed.
